tools.name: decide
tools.description: Ask the Strands Decider decision model (private, in-account SageMaker endpoint over PrivateLink) one or more typed questions about a state, in a single call. Question types: 'choice' (pick one of N named options), 'noul' (yes/no, returns P(yes)), 'score' (rate on an ordered rubric, lowest first). Every choice/score answer carries a calibrated confidence: >=0.9 is right ~95% of the time; below that, confirm or escalate.

state.description: What the decision is about. Put the text under 'request', e.g. {"request": "Help! My payouts have been failing for 3 days!"}.

request.description: The text the questions are asked about.

questions.description: Map of question name -> question. Each question is {"type": "choice"|"noul"|"score", "instructions": "...", "criteria": ...}. choice: criteria is an object of option name -> description or null (2-255 options). noul: criteria optional, {"true": "...", "false": "..."}. score: criteria is an array of 2-10 levels, lowest first. Example: {"team": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which team should handle this?", "criteria": {"billing": null, "sales": null}}}.
